title: kbgit.py install-hooks --uninstall prints core.hooksPath unset without reading whether git config --unset succeeded
goal: kg_hooks names a key as unset only when git config --unset returned success, and refuses with exit 1 when core.hooksPath could not be unset
repro_reason: needs a read-only git config to fail the unset; the planted input is in the notes
notes: SP-mut2pmu3 review gap 8 (S4). kg_hooks.py:203-209 does not read the result of git config --unset core.hooksPath (nor push.recurseSubmodules): when git fails (read-only or locked config, exit 5) the line still says the key is unset. Fix: add a key to the unset list only when git returned success, print a refusal and return 1 for a failed core.hooksPath.
